notes.title: 1.4.2 Update
notes.content: [h3]Character Adjustments[/h3][p]- \[Xiang Chong] Rework[/p][p]- \[Sun Erniang] Increased the number of stages of absorption[/p][p]- \[Lu Zhishen] Increased the initial value[/p][p]- \[Hu Yanzhuo] Increased the initial value[/p][p]- \[Hua Rong]'s attacks now take a portion of the victim's damage, and its attack power has been reduced from 10 to 8[/p][p]- \[Wu Song]'s health plundered has been changed from a fixed value to a percentage, and its bloodlust increases as it takes damage[/p][p]- \[Lu Junyi]'s mechanic effect has been increased from 25% to 50%, and its star upgrade effect has been significantly improved[/p][p]- \[Wu Yong] and \[Song Jiang]: When triggering a rebellion, the rebellious unit will now be at the front of the team[/p][p]- \[Song Jiang]'s price increased from 3 to 4[/p][p]- \[Gongsun Sheng]'s clone now appears at the front of the team, and its price increased from 3 to 4[/p][p]- \[Gu Dasao]'s price reduced from 3 to 2[/p][p][/p][h3]Weapon Adjustments[/h3][p]- \[Tianwang Tower] Rework[/p][p]- \[Gourd]'s mechanic has been added, and it now increases maximum health[/p][p][/p][h3]Enemy Adjustments[/h3][p]- Minor adjustments to the mechanics of Lu Qian and Sun Erniang[/p][p]- Weapon changes for Jiang Menshen and Xue Ba[/p][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][p]- Fixed an issue where Huang Xin and Lin Chong's Hook Spear wasn't triggering.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where clicking the battle button in ranked matches wouldn't work.[/p]

tags.balance_change: - [Sun Erniang] Increased the number of stages of absorption
- [Lu Zhishen] Increased the initial value
- [Hu Yanzhuo] Increased the initial value
- [Hua Rong]'s attacks now take a portion of the victim's damage, and its attack power has been reduced from 10 to 8
- [Wu Song]'s health plundered has been changed from a fixed value to a percentage, and its bloodlust increases as it takes damage
- [Lu Junyi]'s mechanic effect has been increased from 25% to 50%, and its star upgrade effect has been significantly improved
- [Wu Yong] and [Song Jiang]: When triggering a rebellion, the rebellious unit will now be at the front of the team
- [Song Jiang]'s price increased from 3 to 4
- [Gongsun Sheng]'s clone now appears at the front of the team, and its price increased from 3 to 4
- [Gu Dasao]'s price reduced from 3 to 2

tags.feature: - [Gourd]'s mechanic has been added, and it now increases maximum health

tags.bug: - Fixed an issue where Huang Xin and Lin Chong's Hook Spear wasn't triggering.
- Fixed an issue where clicking the battle button in ranked matches wouldn't work.
